# Concerto

> Concerto is a concert companion app for iPhone and Android, and concertocity.com. Save a show and Concerto puts what you need to know about the venue, the tour, and the city around it in one place. Venue guides cover 1,000+ venues worldwide, each researched from the venue's official sources and dated.

## Venue guides
- [All venue guides](https://concertocity.com/venues): bag policy, entrances, parking, rideshare, accessibility, re-entry, and ticket pickup for each venue, with the source and the date it was checked.
- [Venues by state and country](https://concertocity.com/concert-venues/texas): one page per state or country, for example Texas.
- House Map (in the app): a venue’s concourses with every food stand, bar, restroom, and entrance pinned by section, from the venue’s own maps. Live at [Madison Square Garden](https://concertocity.com/venue/madison-square-garden), [Crypto.com Arena](https://concertocity.com/venue/cryptocom-arena), [American Airlines Center](https://concertocity.com/venue/american-airlines-center), and [Scotiabank Arena](https://concertocity.com/venue/scotiabank-arena).
- [Bag policies](https://concertocity.com/bags), [Parking](https://concertocity.com/parking), [Rideshare](https://concertocity.com/rideshare), [Food and drink](https://concertocity.com/concessions): one topic across every venue.

## Blog
- [The Concerto Blog](https://concertocity.com/blog): articles by Concerto, written from official sources. For example, [Jingle Ball 2026](https://concertocity.com/blog/jingle-ball-2026): every stop, lineup, and each arena’s bag rule, re-entry and rideshare pickup.

## Tours and setlists
- [Tours](https://concertocity.com/tours): current tours with dates and the official tour site.
- [Setlists](https://concertocity.com/setlists): the setlist each tour has been playing, labeled by source.

## The app
- [Your Night](https://concertocity.com/features): one page for a saved show, with your own plan for the night: where you eat and stay, getting there and home, your seat, the venue's rules and the setlist.
- [Concerto+](https://concertocity.com/premium): Plan it for me, Bag Check, and Exit Plan. $29.99 a year, or $4.99 for one show.
- [Download](https://concertocity.com/download)
- [Help](https://concertocity.com/help) and [FAQ](https://concertocity.com/faq)
